name: Ålö
description: A challenging, wild-feeling 13.2 km loop on Ålö, with technical coastal cliffs, forest paths, sandy beaches, pasture and gravel-road sections. The strongest public facilities are clustered at Ålö brygga/Båtshaket and Ålö Storsand; elsewhere hikers should be self-sufficient and respect Ålö-Rånö nature reserve rules.
notes: Route shape: counterclockwise loop from Ålö brygga / Båtshaket, with optional handoff to Utö via Ålö Bridge.

facilities.name: Båtshaket
facilities.description: Seasonal summer restaurant beside Ålö brygga and the practical ferry-side service node for the Ålö section. Latest operator page lists 2025 summer opening periods and says some weeks may extend to 20:00 if weather allows; verify current-season hours before live display.

facilities.name: Water pump north of Ålö brygga
facilities.description: Public drinking-water pump at the four-way crossing just north of Ålö brygga. Treat as a normal water source, with island-service caveat to verify locally before relying on it as sole water.

facilities.name: Dry toilet north of Ålö brygga
facilities.description: Public dry toilet at/near the four-way crossing north of Ålö brygga.

facilities.name: Ålö Storsand water pump
facilities.description: Public drinking-water pump at Ålö Storsand. Import as normal water, but show a seasonal/verify-before-relying caveat.

facilities.name: Ålö Storsand dry toilet
facilities.description: Public dry toilet at Ålö Storsand.

facilities.name: Ålö Storsand barbecue areas
facilities.description: Official SAT guide says Ålö Storsand has nice barbecue areas; import as a grouped Storsand BBQ/fireplace cluster rather than individual mapped fire pits.

facilities.name: Laxvik barbecue area
facilities.description: Official SAT guide says Laxvik is a beach with a barbecue area about 1.5 km after Storsand. OSM and Grillplatser corroborate a physical firepit/grill area at Laxviken. Treat nearby duplicate Grillplatser records as the same Laxvik area.

facilities.name: Källviken barbecue area
facilities.description: Official SAT guide says Källviken has a barbecue area about 1.1 km after Laxvik. OSM, Wikidata and Wikimedia/Commons context line up with the route position. Do not use unrelated Grillplatser Källviken pages from other counties.

facilities.name: Ålö Storsand
facilities.description: Long, shallow sandy beach described by SAT, Naturkartan and Länsstyrelsen as one of Ålö's major natural highlights.

facilities.name: Laxvik
facilities.description: Official SAT describes Laxvik as a beautiful beach with a barbecue area about 1.5 km after Storsand and views straight east. OSM maps the beach/bathing-place pin nearby; keep this as a normal beach POI distinct from the Laxvik barbecue marker.
